run_hermes_swe_env_cli: run the HermesSweEnv CLI with serve command, openai base_url, model_name, and dataset_name args
build_swe_env_config: build a HermesSweEnvConfig with terminal, file, web toolsets and modal terminal backend for SWE-bench tasks
test_swe_reward: test the HermesSweEnv compute_reward method by running test_code in a Modal sandbox and checking exit codes
format_swe_prompt: format a SWE task prompt from a dataset item with prompt field and test code for the agent loop
log_swe_metrics: log SWE training metrics including avg_reward and pass_rate to Weights & Biases via wandb_log
